text_block_list.text:
A voice calls out to Голд Шипп in her
dreams,
rousing her spirit. There's no
time to waste! Gold
Ship ventures out in
search of Eden.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Convinced that Eden is a land of the
divine, Gold
Ship decides to become a
god in order to reach
it. However, Super
Creek stands in her path.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite Голд Шип's self-proclaimed
deity powers,
Super Creek deflects her
attacks like it's child's
play—for even
gods have their makers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Creek's maternal spirit transcends
divinity, and
Голд Шип suffers a crushing
defeat in the face of
her motherly love.
To be continued...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
